title: Ascalon armor
wikitext:
*Only available as starter armor in Prophecies, except for the warrior armor. ''(Note: Prophecies starter armor names are included in brackets.)''
*Crafted by [[Nu Leng]] in [[Shing Jea Monastery]], [[Maeko]] in [[Ran Musu Gardens]], [[Fugui Ge]] in [[Seitung Harbor]] and [[Suki]] in [[Kaineng Center]] in Factions
